question: What restriction on life stages is imposed specifically on a śūdra practitioner?
premises: A śūdra may be a householder.
A śūdra must not be in any other stage.
inference: A śūdra is restricted to the householder stage and barred from other āśramas.
plain_english: A śūdra may be a householder, but he should never be a dweller in any other stage.
